name: Maxnerva
description: Unofficial student-built overlay that enhances McGill's Minerva student portal. Not affiliated with McGill University.

content_scripts.//: Registration Overlay — Look Up Course Sections results page.
Registration Overlay support — Student Detail Schedule page, caches current-schedule day/times for the overlay above (Minerva has no single page with both search results and current-schedule times).
Guidance feature — runs on every Minerva page (not scoped to one) so 'Take me there' navigation from the popup can scroll-into-view and highlight the target element on whatever page it lands on.
